# Native CPU inference fixture

`onnx-matmul.onnx` is Microsoft's quick-start MatMul model, with inputs
`a` (3x4), `b` (4x3), and output `c` (3x3).

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime-inference-examples/blob/16e32e87c81648773b8da2a80434a672e3b9dad6/js/quick-start_onnxruntime-node/model.onnx

SHA-256: `8b047f514b304d849a6bfd8e2e758777dd0935812e0cd78ac31513be1fe657a5`.
MIT license retained in `onnx-matmul.LICENSE`.
